title: 15-second audio wrapper with one controlled Inline terminal

source.name: IAB OpenRTB 2.6 Video, Audio and Bid objects
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All IDs, domains, titles, XML and media descriptions are original test data.
Request/response IDs and impid are intentionally paired.
Public examples are references; no real person, cookie, advertising ID, IP address or live tracking endpoint is retained.
provenance.sanitized: No production payload or PII used. All resource and tracking hosts end in .test; external network must remain blocked.

pairApplicability.note: Use x-openrtb-version: 2.6 when replaying HTTP; envelope itself has no version field.

bid.adm: <VAST version="4.1" xmlns="http://www.iab.com/VAST"><Ad id="audio-inapp-26-wrapper" adType="audio"><Wrapper followAdditionalWrappers="false" allowMultipleAds="false" fallbackOnNoAd="false"><AdSystem version="1.0">ortbtools wrapper fixture</AdSystem><Impression><![CDATA[https://track.example.test/audio-inapp-26-wrapper/impression]]></Impression><VASTAdTagURI><![CDATA[https://vast.example.test/audio-inapp-26-wrapper-terminal.xml]]></VASTAdTagURI></Wrapper></Ad></VAST>

specNotes: Wrapper protocol 12 resolves to protocol 11; both supported.
feed 2 is FM/AM live broadcast; wrapper resolution requires explicit local fixture route.
Validity describes protocol structure and declared constraints; generated media bytes must be checked against declared MIME/duration before playback tests.
Current Inspector contract displays VAST as inert XML; text visibility must not be counted as creative rendering or media playback.
fixtureAssets lists controlled resources; intercept .test URLs locally. Never fetch public advertising/tracking hosts.
Companion image visibility is a separate preview capability.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.

preview.capabilityGap: The current VAST preview is inert XML; video/audio playback and Wrapper resolution are not implemented.

knownGap.note: Audio VAST and audio MediaFiles must remain valid and be identified as audio; optional request Device attributes do not invalidate the pair.
